claim: Repeated «أعلى/أسفل/حذف» buttons get per-item names, and delete gets a confirm or undo
evidence: FieldInput.tsx:643-663 and 717-737 now carry aria-labels like `حذف: ${field.label} ${index + 1}` (naming fixed), but «حذف» still runs onChange(items.filter(...)) at once with no confirm or undo (663, 737); see ADMIN-CMS-08.

claim: Autosave never overwrites a local copy on offer, and a save never deletes it or switches autosave off
evidence: The form, Save and the publish bar are not rendered while localOffer is set (CollectionForm.tsx:291-317); save() no longer clears storage (266-271); draftStorageAction returns 'keep' while an offer is pending (fields.ts:234-236).

claim: A restored copy based on an older version warns before replacing newer saved work
evidence: draftOffer returns staleBase when own.baseSeq < loadedSeq (fields.ts:222); the banner says «هذه النسخة المحلية مبنية على النسخة …، والأحدث الآن …؛ استرجاعها يستبدل ما حُفظ بعدها.» (CollectionForm.tsx:302-303).

claim: No pending autosave is lost on unmount or tab close
evidence: Autosave is synchronous on every change, not on a timer (CollectionForm.tsx:196-218). Holds for one tab; a second tab on the same document can remove the copy (ADMIN-CMS-01) and there is still no leave warning.

claim: Unsaved drafts are tied to their author and do not outlive a sign-out
evidence: StoredDraft carries userId (fields.ts:190-196) and draftOffer offers only own or legacy copies (213); signOut confirms then clearDrafts (AdminShell.tsx:128-134); a different user signing in under the tab clears drafts (86).

claim: Only the newest document load applies
evidence: loadTicketRef ticket checked after each await (CollectionForm.tsx:137, 152, 159).

claim: A schedule shows its version and warns, with a one-click reschedule, when newer versions exist
evidence: content_documents.scheduled_seq (20260930140000_audit2_fixes.sql:344-366); PublishBar shows «مجدول: نسخة N في …» and the behind alert with «جدولة النسخة {seq} في الموعد نفسه» (PublishBar.tsx:84, 146-167); CollectionList status (CollectionList.tsx:43-48).

claim: Scheduling refuses a past time and a five-digit year without disabling the bar
evidence: schedule() uses riyadhLocalToIsoOrNull and a Date.parse(at) <= Date.now() check before run() (PublishBar.tsx:71-82); run() catches a throwing task (60); SQL still refuses p_at <= now() (audit2_fixes.sql:256-258).

claim: A pasted tab no longer blocks publishing
evidence: registerAllowlistTransforms replaces TabNode with a one-space text node (RichTextEditor.tsx:219-221); Lexical 0.51's plain-text importer still creates TabNode for a tab (LexicalClipboard.dev.js:352-356), so the transform is needed and present.

claim: Version history reloads after a save
evidence: VersionHistory's effect depends on latestSeq (VersionHistory.tsx:50-56).

claim: The preview banner tells a live version from an unpublished draft
evidence: previewNote compares seq with liveSeq (RoomPreview.tsx:90-94).

claim: «المزيد» cannot fetch a page twice or skip rows
evidence: loadingMore guard and disabled button (MediaLibrary.tsx:228-247, 291), appendPage dedupes by id (151-154), generation guard drops superseded pages (194, 235).

claim: Folder rename runs once, the folder scan reports errors, folders are trimmed, child paths are checked

claim: Where-used and the delete guard include product covers; the folder list is not capped at max_rows
evidence: media_product_usage is called beside media_where_used (MediaLibrary.tsx:415-427); media_delete refuses product covers (20260927180000_store_media.sql:51-75); folders are paged to an empty page (MediaLibrary.tsx:380-395).

claim: One AdminShell for every signed-in screen
evidence: src/app/(admin)/admin/(shell)/layout.tsx mounts AdminShell once; pages render only their view.

claim: A transient role or session failure does not unmount the open screen or redirect to sign-in
evidence: Role RPC error keeps a ready gate (AdminShell.tsx:90-95); getSession error keeps it too (104-112); INITIAL_SESSION is ignored (119).

evidence: loadDirectory after every refusal (TeamView.tsx:93-96) and after the step-up retry (112); loadError renders above the loaded table (150-154). The role select itself can still show a refused edit (ADMIN-CMS-03).

claim: Arabic-Indic digits are accepted in one-time codes
evidence: otpDigits folds U+0660-0669 and U+06F0-06F9 (src/lib/digits.ts:12-17), used by SignIn.tsx:130, StepUp.tsx:84, MfaEnroll.tsx:231.

evidence: 55000 sets STALE_MESSAGE and reloads (EmailView.tsx:98-102); visually-hidden «إجراء» header (203-205); `allowed` check (63, 141-148); SettingsView owner check (106-113).

claim: TeamView uses callFunction with its 200-reply validation

evidence: Object.hasOwn in imageIdSchema/videoIdSchema (fields.ts:266-269), isRoomSlug (collections/index.ts:57-59), RoomPreview (100), images.ts (52).
